segments.text: Almighty God, ſeeing it hath pleaſed thee once to ſhew vs this fauour, not onely to adopt vs for thy children, but alſo to binde vs vnto thee by the bond of ſpirituall marriage, and haſt giuen vs ſo good a pledge thereof in that holy and ſacred vnion which we haue with thy onely Son Ieſus Chriſt: grant we may hold faſt the faith of the Goſpell, and alſo with ſuch fidelity and loyalty keepe that faith which wee haue plighted to thee, that on thy part thou maiſt ſhew thy ſelfe an husband and a father, in ſuch wiſe vnto vs euen vnto the end, that wee may find thy bounty ſo enlarged towards vs, that by meanes thereof we for our parts may alſo be held in the feare of thy holy name, till at the laſt we come to enter into the poſſeſſion of that holy couenant of thy heauenly kingdome, through the ſame our Lord Ieſus Chriſt. Amen.
